assembly_suffix.help_text: Suffix of assembly filename. Only required when the user provides a path to an assemblies directory.

sample_col.help_text: The name of the metadata column that provides the sample ID. Used to match against assembly filenames.

group_label.help_text: The name of the metadata column that groups/clusters samples into colour sets. e.g. Lineage, Serotype etc. Required for colour mapping.

colour_index_kmer_size.help_text: The k-mer size to use for the GGCAT / SBWT / Themisto2 builds. Must be the same across all three tools.

temp_dir.help_text: Shared scratch root for GGCAT/SBWT temp/working dirs. Optional -- falls back to a task-local work directory per tool, which is fine at species scale. Only set this to a Lustre scratch path with confirmed free space if running at full background-DB scale (ATB/GTDB), which needs terabytes free. Each tool writes under '<temp_dir>/<tool>/' -- assumes only one build runs against a given temp_dir at a time.

candidate_min_freq.help_text: Within-lineage presence-fraction cutoff a unitig must clear: 'core' (>=0.95), 'relaxed' (>=0.5), 'catchall' (>0.0), or a literal fraction e.g. '0.8'.

candidate_min_genome_count.help_text: Absolute lineage-genome-count floor, on top of candidate_min_freq. Also the size below which a sister lineage is ignored when computing specificity_max_outside.

specificity_max_outside.help_text: Ceiling on the MAX presence fraction across any single other lineage (not a pooled average across all of them -- that hides a unitig concentrated in one sister lineage). null = not applied, i.e. core-only. 0.05 (the PAT-3570 default) also requires lineage-specificity.

atb_index.help_text: Themisto2 index of AllTheBacteria, one colour per species. Candidate markers are pseudoaligned against it to check they aren't found in other species. The default is the Sanger farm copy.

atb_colour_names.help_text: Colour ID -> ATB species name for --atb_index. Must match that index.

atb_min_within.help_text: Minimum fraction of a marker's k-mers that must be found in the target species (the manifest's species).

atb_max_outside.help_text: Maximum fraction of a marker's k-mers allowed in any other ATB species (except those in the manifest's atb_exclude_species). Independent of --specificity_max_outside.

publish_intermediate.help_text: Publish the per-stage intermediates (GGCAT unitigs, SBWT indexes and dumps, Themisto2 exports and stats). false = keep only the final outputs, including each species' checkpoint/pipeline_counts.tsv; flip on to inspect a run.
